channel.title: The Grant Desk - Grants, Media Arts, Film & Sound, Remote & Worldwide, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Grants, Media Arts, Film & Sound, Remote & Worldwide, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily. Each drop carries at most 10 grants, closest deadlines first; the rest follow the next Sunday.

item.title: 1 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grant - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Statens Kunstfond: Production and Exhibitions, Contemporary Art in Denmark and Abroad (2026 autumn round)
    https://www.kunst.dk/english/funding-programmes/exhibition-of-danish-art-abroad
    Statens Kunstfond (Danish Arts Foundation) · deadline 24 Sep 2026 · DKK. No published minimum or maximum; the committee assesses each application on its merits and historical awards are published on the site. No stated co-financing requirement. No application fee. Applications must be submitted digitally via the Danish subsidy portal (Tilskudsportalen).

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 3 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grants - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:
• KNOWCASE Open Call 2027: permanent digital-culture installation in Madrid (Sonar+D x Fundacion Cotec)
    https://sonar.es/en/news/knowcase-open-call-2027
    Fundacion Cotec and Sonar+D · deadline 07 Sep 2026 · Up to EUR 100,000 (plus VAT), all-inclusive: conceptualisation, design, technical development, production, installation, maintenance, documentation, artist fees, travel, accommodation and insurance.
  • Accion Cultural Espanola: PICE Movilidad 2026 (Phase 3)
    https://www.accioncultural.es/es/movilidad-2026
    Accion Cultural Espanola (AC/E) · deadline 07 Sep 2026 · Max EUR 15,000 per applicant per call, per event and per thematic area; within that, max EUR 5,000 per participant or collective. Total 2026 call budget EUR 1,810,000 (Musica y creacion sonora EUR 320,000, Artes visuales EUR 200,000, Videojuego y animacion EUR 90,000, Arquitectura y diseno EUR 90,000, Podcast EUR 90,000). Mandatory co-financing: the applicant must commit at least 50 percent of each proposal's total budget. No application fee.
  • The Japan Foundation: Exhibitions Abroad Support Program (FY2027-28 round)
    https://www.jpf.org.uk/artsandculture/funding.php
    The Japan Foundation · deadline 01 Dec 2026 · No published ceiling. Partial-cost grant only: packing and shipping of Japanese exhibits (insurance excluded), catalogue production including digital catalogues, and travel for invited Japanese artists, curators and specialists. Preliminary research and development explicitly excluded. The grant is partial by design, so the host institution funds the balance. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 6 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grants - week of 06 Jul 2026
item.description:
• Mountainfilm: Commitment Grants & Emerging Filmmaker Fellowship
    https://www.mountainfilm.org/mountainfilm-initiatives/commitment-grants/
    Mountainfilm · deadline Closed 16 Jul 2026 · Over USD 90,000 in total funding. Individual Commitment Grants range from USD 3,000 to 6,000. The Emerging Filmmaker Fellowship adds a yearlong mentorship, a cash award, and a funded trip to Telluride over Memorial Day weekend (travel, lodging, and a festival pass).
  • Prospect Art: NEW WORK Commission 2027 - "We Come in Pieces"
    https://www.prospectart.org/new-work-grant
    Prospect Art · deadline Closed 16 Aug 2026 · NEW WORK: USD 1,500 commission for one artist, plus a featured website section and social promotion. BROADCAST: USD 125 screening or speaking fee if selected. ONE WORK: a published article (exposure). NOTE: a USD 10 administrative fee applies to apply, with a no-questions-asked waiver available on request before the deadline. PayPal account required to receive funds.
  • Doc Society: Climate Story Fund
    https://climatestoryunit.org/fund/
    Doc Society (Climate Story Unit) · deadline Closed 24 Aug 2026 · Grants of up to USD 125,000. No application fee.

    https://www.lsmartfund.org/grants
    Liu Shiming Art Foundation · deadline Closed 31 Aug 2026 · Up to five grants of USD 5,000 each. Disbursed in two payments (USD 3,000 by 15 January 2027 and USD 2,000 on project completion). No application fee.

    https://www.fondazioneprada.org/film-fund/?lang=en

  • Pollock-Krasner Foundation Grant for Artists
    https://www.pkf.org/grants/grant-for-artists/
